hook_text: A circuit on the left, a recycling plant and a drawing on the right. The whole second half of the year on one wall.
clip_script: Term 3 in a breath: series shares voltage, parallel shares current, V equals I times R with units. Resistor, LED, LDR, thermistor, transistor as a switch, capacitor for delay. AND, OR, NOT and truth tables. Safety, fuses, earth, load shedding. Your device built and tested. Term 4 in a breath: rust needs air and water; paint, zinc, plating. Dry, salt, pickle. Plastics soften or char, codes 1 to 7, reduce, reuse, recycle in that order. The plant: sort, shred, wash, float, dry, extrude, pelletise, drawn as three boxes with feedback. Four ways to mould, four design rules. Car and home, material and property. Need, brief, specs, drawing. In the exam: read the command word, use the proper terms, show working with units, label every diagram, a mark a minute. You have done all of this. Now show it.
visual_style: Whiteboard split wall: left circuit diagram with Ohm's law, right systems diagram and three-view drawing; a command-word list with mark values; a clock with a mark a minute.
mood: Steady, confident, coach before a match.
pacing: Term 3 map, Term 4 map, command words, diagrams, time.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and redraw both halves of the wall from memory tonight, then mark what you missed.
